name: Okuno Chitose
source:
Daughter of "Yatara Shrine" located in the back of Yatara Hot Spring Village. She is a friend of Kanoko's.

After graduating from high school, she married  without going on to higher education, and took over the shrine as a priestess to protect it.

She is a ladylike and glamorous woman who looks good with glasses. She is now a married woman who has acquired the charm of an adult.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/bokunatsu.html]official site[/url]]
